name: Shawn Mendes
description:
'''Shawn Peter Raul Mendes''' ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|m|ɛ|n|d|ɛ|z}} {{respell|MEN|dez}}, {{IPA|pt-PT|ˈmẽdɨʃ|lang}}; born August 8, 1998) is a Canadian singer, songwriter, and musician. Mendes gained early recognition for posting popular song covers on the social media platforms [[YouTube]] and [[Vine (service)|Vine]]. He later signed to [[Island Records]] and released his  [[The Shawn Mendes EP|self-titled debut EP]] in 2014. 

Mendes's debut studio album, ''[[Handwritten (Shawn Mendes album)|Handwritten]]'' (2015), debuted atop the US [[Billboard 200|''Billboard'' 200]] and featured his breakout single "[[Stitches (Shawn Mendes song)|Stitches]]", which reached number one in the UK and the top 10 in the US and Canada. His second studio album, ''[[Illuminate (Shawn Mendes album)|Illuminate]]'' (2016), produced a string of successful singles, including  "[[Treat You Better (Shawn Mendes song)|Treat You Better]]", "[[Mercy (Shawn Mendes song)|Mercy]]", and "[[There's Nothing Holdin' Me Back]]". His [[Shawn Mendes (album)|self-titled third studio album]] featured the lead single "[[In My Blood (Shawn Mendes song)|In My Blood]]", while its deluxe edition included the hit singles "[[If I Can't Have You (Shawn Mendes song)|If I Can't Have You]]" and "[[Señorita (Shawn Mendes and Camila Cabello song)|Señorita]]"; the latter became his first US [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] number-one single. His fourth studio album, ''[[Wonder (Shawn Mendes album)|Wonder]]'' (2020), made him the youngest male artist ever to top the ''Billboard'' 200 with four studio albums. After a brief hiatus, Mendes released his [[folk music|folk]]-driven fifth studio album, [[Shawn (album)|''Shawn'']] (2024).

[[List of awards and nominations received by Shawn Mendes|Mendes's accolades]] include thirteen [[Society of Composers, Authors and Music Publishers of Canada|SOCAN]] awards, ten [[MTV Europe Music Award]]s, eight [[Juno Award]]s, eight [[iHeartRadio MMVAs]], two [[American Music Awards]], in addition to nominations for three [[Grammy Awards]] and a [[Brit Award]]. In 2018, ''[[Time (magazine)|Time]]'' named him one of the 100 most influential people in the world on their [[Time 100|annual list]].
